faq.q: How does the voice-controlled mask work?
faq.a: A small motor and onboard mic open and close the faceplate on a spoken command. You can also open and close it manually anytime.

faq.q: Is this a real motorcycle helmet?
faq.a: No — the StrikeGear helmet is a display and costume piece for collecting, cosplay, and display. It is not protective safety gear and is not intended for riding.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: A full USB-C charge keeps the faceplate motor and LED eyes running through plenty of display and dress-up sessions before it needs topping up.

faq.q: Can I still open the faceplate by hand?
faq.a: Yes. The voice command is a convenience feature — the faceplate also opens and closes manually at any time.
It's a one-size display helmet with adjustable interior padding, built to fit most adults comfortably for display and costume use.
